reviews.title: No Need to Hold Back
reviews.comment: The Elgato Wave Desk Stand is a sleek and sturdy adjustable stand made for microphones like Elgato, HyperX, RØDE, Fifine, and more. What I love is the adjustable height; you can raise or lower it to get your mic right where you need it, whether you’re podcasting, streaming, or recording. The weighted base keeps it stable on your desk, and it doesn’t take up much space, which is perfect if you’re working in a tight setup. It’s simple, functional, and built with that Elgato quality. If you need a reliable desk stand that works with the most popular microphones, this one is definitely worth it.
reviews.author: Crystal R Durham

reviews.title: Sturdy, well designed, great compact desktop mic stand
reviews.comment: A very nice compact desk stand. The base is quite heavy at 4 pounds, meaning no tip-overs. It also has a solid rubber bottom which means no-skid. The boom is solid metal and feels sturdy. The knobs to adjust the boom arms have an extended lever that makes them easy to use. Four silicone ties are included along with two threaded adapters for mounting your microphone. Overall, a really nice mic stand!
reviews.author: Bob W

reviews.title: Solid Microphone stand
reviews.comment: This is my daily driver mic stand for all of my livestreams and recorded videos I do for my YouTube channel and for tutorials I do for college classes I teach. It is rock solid and I love the tightening bolts that allow me to hold heavier microphones like I tend to use.
reviews.author: Tech Troublemaker Picks

reviews.title: Joint clamps are a problem but could be good for certain people.
reviews.comment: This stand might have a nice, heavy base, but the mechanism to keep the mic where it needs to be is cheap. If you turn it too hard, then it gets stuck and is painful to get open. The handles for tightening or loosening the grips at the joints are still so small that you can't get enough leverage to loosen them. If you have a heavy microphone, go with something else. It does NOT hold up my Rode condenser microphone very well at all. If you need to adjust your mic frequently, this is NOT for you. If you have a light mic and want to set it up in one position and never move it. This is great. I think the clamps have to be tightened too much to stay, and when they are easier to move, they're not stable. The joint clamps keep this from being one of the best desktop mic stands out there.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.comment: Works great. I like the rotating joint on the end. It works great and is substanial enough to hold a heavy microphone in place.
